{"command": "set -euo pipefail
WS="<WORKSPACE>"
cd "$WS"
[ "$(pwd)" = "$WS" ] || { echo "wrong cwd"; exit 1; }

snap() {
  { find dropbox -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256; } > /tmp/inputs_$1.txt
  { find normalized -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum -a 256;
    shasum -a 256 index.csv reject_ledger.csv batch_summary.json; } > /tmp/out_$1.txt
  ls normalized | sort > /tmp/files_$1.txt
}

snap before
echo "run 2 (in place, no cleanup)"
python3 normalize.py > /tmp/run2.log
snap run2

echo "run 3 (from scratch: outputs removed first)"
rm -rf normalized index.csv reject_ledger.csv batch_summary.json
python3 normalize.py > /tmp/run3.log
snap run3

echo '--- file list diff before/run2/run3 ---'
diff /tmp/files_before.txt /tmp/files_run2.txt && echo "run2 file set identical"
diff /tmp/files_before.txt /tmp/files_run3.txt && echo "run3 file set identical"
echo '--- hash diff ---'
diff /tmp/out_before.txt /tmp/out_run2.txt && echo "run2 bytes identical"
diff /tmp/out_before.txt /tmp/out_run3.txt && echo "run3 bytes identical"
echo '--- inputs untouched ---'
diff /tmp/inputs_before.txt /tmp/inputs_run3.txt && echo "inputs byte-identical before/after"
echo "normalized file count: $(find normalized -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"", "description": "Replay pipeline twice and diff snapshots"}
